marketObservation.finding: The current 15-minute velocity feature is useful but insufficient by itself. Multiple movers show strong session gains while short-window momentum is deteriorating, and CRE demonstrates an extreme velocity print that needs a data-quality/sanity layer. The next improvement should measure multi-horizon persistence and bar-quality before a velocity-driven Wake-Up is trusted.

TAGX therefore remains focused on small-cap idiosyncratic regime shifts rather than index direction.
